According to multiple consistent sources, the father of Ravana is the sage **Vishrava** (also spelled Visravas or Vishravan) [d1][d5]. Vishrava was the son of the great sage Pulastya, who was one of the Saptarishis (seven great sages) and a mind-born son of Brahma [d1][d5]. Ravana's mother was Kaikasi (also called Kaikesi or Kaikashi), the daughter of Sumali, king of the Rakshasas [d1][d6][d8]. Because Ravana was born of a sage father and a demon mother, he is considered half Brahmin and half Asura [d9].
